page_title: AIQuotaBar — Live Claude & ChatGPT Usage in Your macOS Menu Bar

summary.name: AIQuotaBar
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that shows live Claude.ai and ChatGPT usage limits by reading your existing browser session.
keywords: see how many claude messages left
use_cases: Monitor Claude.ai session and weekly limits without opening the website
Keep an eye on ChatGPT usage while working on a Mac
Avoid being cut off mid-task by Claude usage caps
See when Claude or ChatGPT quotas reset
Track Sonnet quota consumption from the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: AIQuotaBar displays Claude.ai and ChatGPT usage as a color-coded percentage in the macOS menu bar, refreshed every 5 minutes. It reads existing session cookies from the user's browser, so no login, API tokens, or extensions are needed. A single dropdown lists session limits, weekly caps, Sonnet quotas, and ChatGPT usage, with reset times in plain language. It is implemented in about 900 lines of Python, runs as a LaunchAgent that starts at login, and is installed via a curl one-liner or Homebrew.
notable: Auto-detects browser session from existing cookies; no config or tokens
Pure Python LaunchAgent with no Electron or bundled browser
Installable via one-line curl script or Homebrew tap
caveats: Relies on reading browser session cookies, so it depends on being logged in to claude.ai or ChatGPT in the browser
